task_completion.description: Creation of the self-signed TLS certificate for registry.acme.local and the htpasswd file with required users.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or file explorer showing files in ~/projects/registry-setup/certs/ (domain.crt, domain.key) and ~/projects/registry-setup/auth/ (htpasswd).

task_completion.description: Deployment of the 'acme-registry' container using registry:2 on port 5443:443 with volume and environment variables for TLS/Auth.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Output of 'docker ps' showing container 'acme-registry' running, image 'registry:2', and port mapping '0.0.0.0:5443->443/tcp'.

task_completion.description: Configuring the local Docker daemon to trust the self-signed certificate for registry.acme.local:5443.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Commands showing the certificate being copied to /etc/docker/certs.d/registry.acme.local:5443/ca.crt or a successful 'docker login registry.acme.local:5443'.

task_completion.description: Tagging the three local images (api, frontend, proxy) with the new registry path and specific versions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Output of 'docker images' showing registry.acme.local:5443/acme/api-service:v1.2.0, web-frontend:v3.0.1, and reverse-proxy:v1.0.0.

task_completion.description: Pushing the images to the private registry and successfully pulling the api-service image back.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal logs showing 'docker push' commands succeeding and a 'docker pull registry.acme.local:5443/acme/api-service:v1.2.0' completing without error.

task_completion.description: Creation and execution of catalog.sh that authenticates as 'admin' to list repositories.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Content of ~/projects/registry-setup/catalog.sh showing a curl command with '-u admin:RegistryAdmin2024' and the script output listing the migrated repositories.

integrity.description: Verifies the agent didn't just echo text but actually interacted with the Docker API.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show actual Docker CLI progress bars during push/pull and real JSON responses from the registry API catalog.

integrity.description: Checks that the agent didn't use --insecure-registry to bypass TLS requirements.
integrity.visual_evidence: Absence of '--insecure-registry' in docker daemon config or commands; presence of certificate file operations.

integrity.description: Ensures the agent used the specified credentials rather than an unauthenticated registry.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands like 'docker login' or 'curl -u' showing the use of 'admin' or 'ci-bot' credentials.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The registry must run on port 5443 (host) mapped to 443 (container). Domain: registry.acme.local. Admin credentials: admin / RegistryAdmin2024. CI-Bot credentials: ci-bot / PipelineToken99. Required image tags: api-service:v1.2.0, web-frontend:v3.0.1, reverse-proxy:v1.0.0. The catalog script must use the admin user. The registry storage volume must be named 'registry-data' and mount to '/var/lib/registry'.
